referee_caveats_inferred: Stellar angular diameter is given as 41.4 mas in the Introduction but 40.7 mas in the continuum appendix; the R* scaling of the quoted radii depends on which is used
The 251 GHz line is only tentatively identified, so the thermal-versus-maser contrast rests on an uncertain identification
Maser conclusion relies on a private-communication model grid and on atmospheric model densities, not on measured line brightness temperatures versus saturation or on polarization
Image registration of ZIMPOL to ALMA assumes the centres of the elliptical disk fits coincide, which is not independently tested
No uncertainties are given on most velocity extents and positions

data_public_as_stated.value: ZIMPOL data are described as archival; the paper does not state the public status of the ALMA data

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 50-200 GB of raw ALMA data for a 9-spectral-window long-baseline (16 km) dataset, plus a small amount of ESO SPHERE data
reproducibility.score_reason: Observations, array configuration, CASA version, robust value and several fit results are stated, and the ZIMPOL data are archival; but imaging, self-calibration and extraction details are missing, and the main results are largely maps and spectra read qualitatively.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main results are mostly image morphology and qualitative velocity ranges, and key imaging, self-calibration and extraction settings are not given, so a numeric redo is not well defined from the paper alone.
